name: castellan
description: Local-first secrets manager: KeePass-compatible vault, authenticator and soft security key, syncing between your own devices over the LAN

scripts.codegen:check: bun run codegen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/protocol/src/generated packages/wasm/src/generated apps/desktop/src/generated apps/mobile/src/generated apps/extension/src/generated apps/extension/native-hosts/generated && ! git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -- packages/protocol/src/generated packages/wasm/src/generated apps/desktop/src/generated apps/mobile/src/generated apps/extension/src/generated apps/extension/native-hosts/generated | grep .
scripts.wasm: sh -c 'wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target bundler --out-dir ../../packages/wasm/src/pkg --scope castellan; status=$?; rm -f packages/wasm/src/pkg/.gitignore; exit $status'
